duckdb -readonly -csv server-logs/gate2/gate2.db "ATTACH 'server-logs/ferda7/ferda7.db' AS f (READ_ONLY); WITH c AS (SELECT c_ip, cs_user_agent ua, min(strptime(time_local,'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z')) t444, max(CASE WHEN http_referer LIKE 'https://www.kili.cz/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ref_www, max(CASE WHEN cs_uri LIKE '/pokladna/kosik%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) kosik FROM access WHERE sc_status='444' AND substr(time_local,4,8) IN ('Sep/2026','Oct/2026') AND cs_uri LIKE '/pokladna/%' AND isrobot='0' AND http_referer<>'https://kili.cz/' AND NOT (cs_user_agent LIKE '%Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7%Chrome/120.0.0.0%' AND http_referer='-') AND cs_user_agent NOT LIKE '%Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64%Chrome/118.0.0.0 Safari/537.3%' AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(cs_user_agent),'bot|spider|crawl|curl|python|wget') GROUP BY 1,2), o AS (SELECT c_ip, cs_user_agent ua, strptime(time_local,'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z') tobj FROM f.wdt WHERE domain='www.kili.cz' AND cs_uri_stem LIKE '/pokladna/dekujeme/%' AND sc_status='200' AND substr(time_local,4,8) IN ('Sep/2026','Oct/2026')) SELECT ref_www, count(*) navst, sum(kosik) s_kosikem, count(DISTINCT c_ip) ips, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.c_ip=c.c_ip AND o.ua=c.ua AND o.tobj>c.t444)) obj_pozdeji, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.c_ip=c.c_ip AND o.tobj>c.t444)) obj_pozdeji_jen_ip FROM c GROUP BY ROLLUP(ref_www) ORDER BY ref_www"
duckdb -readonly -csv server-logs/gate2/gate2.db "ATTACH 'server-logs/ferda7/ferda7.db' AS f (READ_ONLY); WITH c AS (SELECT substr(time_local,1,11) den, c_ip, cs_user_agent ua, min(strptime(time_local,'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z')) t444, max(CASE WHEN http_referer LIKE 'https://www.kili.cz/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ref_www, max(CASE WHEN cs_uri LIKE '/pokladna/kosik%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) kosik FROM access WHERE sc_status='444' AND substr(time_local,4,8) IN ('Sep/2026','Oct/2026') AND cs_uri LIKE '/pokladna/%' AND isrobot='0' AND http_referer<>'https://kili.cz/' AND NOT (cs_user_agent LIKE '%Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7%Chrome/120.0.0.0%' AND http_referer='-') AND cs_user_agent NOT LIKE '%Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64%Chrome/118.0.0.0 Safari/537.3%' AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(cs_user_agent),'bot|spider|crawl|curl|python|wget') GROUP BY 1,2,3), o AS (SELECT c_ip, cs_user_agent ua, strptime(time_local,'%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z') tobj FROM f.wdt WHERE domain='www.kili.cz' AND cs_uri_stem LIKE '/pokladna/dekujeme/%' AND sc_status='200' AND substr(time_local,4,8) IN ('Sep/2026','Oct/2026')) SELECT c.den, count(*) navst, sum(kosik) s_kosikem, sum(ref_www) s_ref_www, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.c_ip=c.c_ip AND o.ua=c.ua AND o.tobj>c.t444)) obj_pozdeji, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ref_www=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.c_ip=c.c_ip AND o.ua=c.ua AND o.tobj>c.t444)) obj_pozdeji_ref_www, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.c_ip=c.c_ip AND o.ua=c.ua AND o.tobj>c.t444 AND o.tobj<c.t444+INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) obj_do_24h FROM c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY strptime(c.den,'%d/%b/%Y')"
duckdb -csv ":memory:" "INSTALL inet; LOAD inet; SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cidr LIKE '%:%') v6, count(TRY_CAST(cidr AS INET)) ok, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v<>'1;') bad FROM read_csv('repos/docker/openresty/conf/geo/gcp.conf', delim=' ', header=false, comment='#', columns={'cidr':'VARCHAR','v':'VARCHAR'})"
duckdb -csv ":memory:" "INSTALL inet; LOAD inet; WITH l AS (SELECT split_part(trim(x),' ',1) cidr, split_part(trim(x),' ',2) v FROM (SELECT unnest(string_split(content, chr(10))) x FROM read_text('repos/docker/openresty/conf/geo/gcp.conf')) WHERE trim(x)<>'' AND NOT starts_with(trim(x),'#')) SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cidr LIKE '%:%') v6, count(TRY_CAST(cidr AS INET)) ok, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v<>'1;') bad FROM l"
duckdb tmp/kili-gcp/w.db "INSTALL inet; LOAD inet; ATTACH 'server-logs/gate2/gate2.db' AS g (READ_ONLY); CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gcp AS SELECT split_part(trim(x),' ',1)::INET cidr FROM (SELECT unnest(string_split(content, chr(10))) x FROM read_text('repos/docker/openresty/conf/geo/gcp.conf')) WHERE trim(x)<>'' AND NOT starts_with(trim(x),'#'); CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE c AS SELECT time_local, regexp_extract(domain,'([^ ]+)$',1) dom, c_ip, sc_status, cs_method, cs_uri, isrobot, cs_user_agent, http_referer, rid FROM g.access WHERE regexp_extract(domain,'([^ ]+)$',1) IN ('www.kili.cz','kili.cz','edit.kili.cz') AND regexp_matches(cs_uri,'(?i)[?&]_ch_sessid=[^&#]'); CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ipmap AS SELECT i.c_ip, max(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(i.c_ip AS INET) <<= gcp.cidr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) is_gcp FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c_ip FROM c) i LEFT JOIN gcp ON TRY_CAST(i.c_ip AS INET) <<= gcp.cidr GROUP BY 1; SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM gcp) cidrs, (SELECT count(*) FROM c) rows_c, (SELECT count(*) FROM ipmap) ips, (SELECT sum(is_gcp) FROM ipmap) gcp_ips, (SELECT count(*) FROM ipmap WHERE TRY_CAST(c_ip AS INET) IS NULL) badip"
